verdict.rationale: Apify documents a managed proxy service that rotates datacenter and residential IPs (apify-docs-8), and its SDK supports Apify Proxy, custom proxies and session-based IP rotation (apify-docs-34, apify-docs-31). None of the evidence mentions selecting a proxy by country or getting geolocation-specific content, so only the general proxy foundation is shown. Missing for 10: documented country-code or geo-targeting parameter, example of requesting a country-specific proxy, list of supported countries, independent or hands-on confirmation of geo-targeted results.
